description: Get Video CDN statistics. Reports: 'monthly_totals' — totals for the current month (requires resource_id); 'timeseries' — per-resource stats over start_date..end_date (requires resource_id); 'by_domains' — per-domain stats (requires resource_id and domains); 'top_domains' — top rated domains of a resource (requires resource_id); 'http_codes' — per-resource HTTP code stats (requires resource_id); 'bandwidth' — account bandwidth (optional resource_id filter); 'cache_storage' — cache and storage usage; 'global_http_codes' — account-wide HTTP code stats. Dates in ISO format, e.g. '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'. start_date and end_date are REQUIRED for every report except monthly_totals.
name: get_vcdn_statistics
title: Get vCDN statistics
